card.statement:
(i) $M(\lambda)$ is a $U({\mathfrak g}_-^{(S)})$-free
module of rank 1 generated by
the $S$-highest weight vector $1\otimes 1$ of weight $\lambda$.\newline
(ii) $\dim M(\lambda)_{\lambda} =1$; $0<\dim M(\lambda)_{\lambda - k \delta} < \infty$
for any integer $k>0$; if $\mu \neq \lambda- k\delta$ for any integer
$k \ge 0$ and
$M(\lambda)_{\mu} \neq 0$, then $\dim M(\lambda)_{\mu} = \infty$.\newline
(iii) Let $V$ be a $U(A_1^{(1)})$-module generated by some $S$-highest
weight vector $v$
of weight $\lambda$. Then there exists a unique surjective homomorphism
$\varphi:M(\lambda) \to V$ such that $\varphi(1 \otimes 1) =v$. \newline
(iv) $M(\lambda)$ has a unique maximal submodule. \newline
(v) Let $\lambda, \mu \in P$. Any non-zero element of
$\text{Hom}\,_{U(A_1^{(1)})}(M(\lambda),M(\mu))$ is
injective.\newline
(vi) $M(\lambda)$ is irreducible if and only if $\lambda(c)\neq 0$.
\hskip 1cm $\square$
card.label: Proposition 1

paper.title: Imaginary Verma modules and Kashiwara algebras for $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$
paper.abstract: We consider imaginary Verma modules for quantum affine algebra $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ and construct Kashiwara type operators and the Kashiwara algebra $\mathcal K_q$. We show that a certain quotient $\mathcal N_q^-$ of $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ is a simple $\mathcal K_q$-module.
